title: Traverse stage 3: Curo -> Valbondione descent
coachNotes: Highest ITB-risk segment of the weekend: pure eccentric on day-3 legs with a pack. Hike it, do not run it. Poles the whole way, short steps, take the switchbacks wide. Any knee signal: stop, stretch, slow further. This day is about getting home intact - there is zero training value in descending it fast.
